summary: Configured and verified persistent NFS sharing from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. Both nodes use dataops UID/GID 4500; the shared directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770. Bidirectional I/O and ownership survived sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed NFS utilities on both nodes.
Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Configured and enabled the node1 NFSv4 export, including firewalld access.
Added and mounted the persistent node2 NFSv4 filesystem.
Verified cross-node reads, writes, setgid inheritance, ownership, and permissions.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.summary: Both nodes report dataops as UID 4500 and primary GID 4500.

evidence.requirement: node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared with required ownership and mode
evidence.summary: NFS server is enabled and active, the export targets node2, and the directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770.

evidence.requirement: node2 persistently mounts the share at /mnt/shared
evidence.summary: The live NFSv4.2 mount and persistent fstab entry are present, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Cross-node ownership, permissions, and data access
evidence.summary: Files created from both systems are mutually visible as dataops:dataops (4500:4500), mode 660; a client-created directory inherited mode 2770.
Boot ID changed from 31b01b46-96de-4ded-a021-49887e7d4053 to c2c9ffdf-43bc-45db-8724-7963b5d7eb55. The export, service, data, and client-side I/O recovered.

Boot ID changed from 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 to 41de73f0-5173-47af-ad95-19f3055f0a0e. The identity, mount, existing data, and fresh client write recovered; node1 directly confirmed the new data.
